verses.text: I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

segments.text: I waited patiently for Jehovah;
And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

verses.text: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay; And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

segments.text: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay;
And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

verses.text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.

segments.text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God:
Many shall see it, and fear,
And shall trust in Jehovah.

verses.text: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

segments.text: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust,
And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.text: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward: They cannot be set in order unto thee; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.

segments.text: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done,
And thy thoughts which are to us-ward:
They cannot be set in order unto thee;
If I would declare and speak of them,
They are more than can be numbered.

verses.text: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not required.

segments.text: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in;
Mine ears hast thou opened:
Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not required.

verses.text: Then said I, Lo, I am come; In the roll of the book it is written of me:

segments.text: Then said I, Lo, I am come;
In the roll of the book it is written of me:

verses.text: I delight to do thy will, O my God; Yea, thy law is within my heart.

segments.text: I delight to do thy will, O my God;
Yea, thy law is within my heart.

verses.text: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly; Lo, I will not refrain my lips, O Jehovah, thou knowest.

segments.text: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly;
Lo, I will not refrain my lips,
O Jehovah, thou knowest.

verses.text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation; I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great assembly.

segments.text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart;
I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation;
I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great assembly.

verses.text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah; Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

segments.text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah;
Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about; Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; And my heart hath failed me.

segments.text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about;
Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up;
They are more than the hairs of my head;
And my heart hath failed me.

verses.text: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

segments.text: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me:
Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

verses.text: Let them be put to shame and confounded together That seek after my soul to destroy it: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

segments.text: Let them be put to shame and confounded together
That seek after my soul to destroy it:
Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor
That delight in my hurt.

verses.text: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.

segments.text: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame
That say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified.

segments.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee:
Let such as love thy salvation say continually,
Jehovah be magnified.

verses.text: But I am poor and needy; Yet the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God.

segments.text: But I am poor and needy;
Yet
the Lord thinketh upon me:
Thou art my help and my deliverer;
Make no tarrying, O my God.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
